draftBefore.emotion: a practical, everyday habit of getting dressed and starting the morning
notes: In Spanish, 'pantalones' is grammatically plural even when referring to a single garment. You must use plural articles and adjectives with it (e.g., 'mis pantalones nuevos' for 'my new pants').

In Mexico, 'pantalones' is the standard term. In other parts of the world, specifically in Spain, you may often hear 'pantalones' but the term 'pantalón' is also frequently used in the singular for a single pair of pants.
